description: Known-answer vectors for the ML-DSA-65 verification primitive (FIPS 204, pure mode) and profile v2 examples. Generated and verified by go/internal/mldsavectors with crypto/mldsa, and re-verified by spec/ml_dsa_65.py. Each case states the exact expected verify result.
test_seed_warning: Every seed in this file is public and test-only. Never use any of them as a real key.

keys.seed_derivation: SHA-256("iff-x402 ml-dsa-65 primitive vector 0"); public test-only seed
SHA-256("iff-x402 ml-dsa-65 primitive vector 1"); public test-only seed
SHA-256("iff-x402 ml-dsa-65 primitive vector 2"); public test-only seed
SHA-256("iff-x402 ml-dsa-65 primitive vector 3"); public test-only seed
SHA-256("iff-x402 ml-dsa-65 primitive vector 4"); public test-only seed
SHA-256("iff-x402 ml-dsa-65 primitive vector 5"); public test-only seed

cases.name: key3_hedged_a
cases.note: randomized signing; the checked-in signature is an input to the byte-for-byte check

cases.name: key4_hedged_b
cases.note: randomized signing; the checked-in signature is an input to the byte-for-byte check

cases.name: neg_flip_c_tilde_last
cases.note: top bit of the last c-tilde byte flipped

cases.name: neg_flip_z_first
cases.note: one bit flipped in the first z coefficient

cases.name: neg_flip_z_mid
cases.note: one bit flipped in the middle of z

cases.name: neg_flip_hint_index
cases.note: one bit flipped in the first hint index byte

cases.name: neg_flip_hint_count
cases.note: one bit flipped in the first hint count byte

cases.name: neg_hint_counts_decrease
cases.note: cumulative hint counts are not non-decreasing

cases.name: neg_hint_indices_decreasing
cases.note: hint indices 7,3 in one polynomial are decreasing

cases.name: neg_hint_indices_equal
cases.note: hint indices 5,5 in one polynomial are equal

cases.name: neg_hint_nonzero_padding
cases.note: a hint slot past the final count is nonzero

cases.name: neg_z_at_gamma1_minus_beta
cases.note: first z coefficient crafted to exactly gamma1-beta, which fails the norm bound

cases.name: neg_z_at_gamma1
cases.note: first z coefficient crafted to gamma1 (field 0), far above the bound

cases.name: neg_wrong_message
cases.note: message differs from the signed one

cases.name: neg_wrong_context
cases.note: signed with an empty context, verified with context 'x'

cases.name: neg_missing_context
cases.note: signed with a non-empty context, verified with an empty one

cases.name: neg_context_256_bytes
cases.note: context longer than 255 bytes is rejected

cases.name: neg_wrong_key
cases.note: valid signature of key 0 verified under key 1

profile_v2_examples.description: One signed tree head and one monitor report signed exactly per spec/x402-signatures-ml-dsa-65.md section 4 and 5, with public test-only seeds and deterministic signing.
